title: Pause step on the choice tape
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be a Boolean oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. Suppose an added tape has content $T$ and head position $p$, with $T(p)=b$, and let $r\in\{0,1,2\}$. From the configuration obtained by adding this tape and putting the control in auxiliary state $r$, one step of the constructed machine yields the configuration based on $c$ with its state set to $q_{\mathrm{yes}}$ if $r=0$ and to $q_{\mathrm{no}}$ otherwise, while the added tape head moves to $p+1$.

b is a Boolean symbol stored at p
